Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner selected B (uplifting of a mountain) by focusing on an indirect mechanism (erosion-induced isostatic rebound) rather than the “most directly related” surface change to the water cycle. The correct choice is A (deposition of sediments), which directly results from water-driven processes like runoff and stream transport. The Planner also prematurely marked the task complete without systematically evaluating all options or engaging specialists.
